title: Ratatouille with white beans and quinoa
steps: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in 160 ml salted water for 15 minutes.
Dice the aubergine, courgette, pepper and onion, chop the garlic and dice the tofu.
Fry the aubergine and tofu in the oil for 6 minutes, add the remaining vegetables and garlic and fry for 5 more minutes.
Add the tomatoes, beans and thyme and simmer covered for 20 minutes, then season.
Sprinkle with basil and serve with the quinoa.
